title: Unit Event — Desperate Times?! Island Panic! — Episode5 Operation Capture The Monkeys!

meta.Event Outline: After a very successful performance at the music hall, Wonderlands×Showtime gets to take a cruiser to their next ambassadorial show venue. But what are they going to do when they all wake up on a desert island after running into a storm...?!

rows.Line: Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Oooook...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Finally, I've got you cornered...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Give up and prepare to be captured...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come! Here! You!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook! Ook! Ooook♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you didn't get any of them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I know!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... They won't stop moving...
And I get the feeling that they're making fun of me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they don't seem to be taking our efforts seriously.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bah... After spending so much energy running here too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh... That's enough!
Forget the bananas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
But we came all this way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What choice do we have?
Nene was right. City kids like us don't stand a chance against these monkeys' natural toughness.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And it's not like we lost everything...
We still have a bucket full of wild herbs and berries!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen, Nene.
You absolutely need to protect this bucket. We can't afford to have our lifeline get stolen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I know...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, let's head back!
I'm sure Shosuke's worked up quite an appetite and is eagerly awaiting our return!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right. I'll also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've come up with a little plan.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
These monkeys seem very smart.
I think they've been closely observing our actions and how we talk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, we may actually be able to fight by doing what we're best at...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What we're best at...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, do you mean acting?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we can do a little skit.
Here's my plan...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When we corner them, we'll act like we're giving up. Then, we'll say, “We don't need those bananas,” and show them that we still have a bucket full of food.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My guess is that they'll try to take our bucket along with the bananas, which is when we'll let loose our trap.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can capture the monkeys by throwing a net over them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I see.
But how do you plan on getting a net?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought we could make one out of the vine I picked up earlier and some of the torn fishing nets that I found along the coast.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we can somehow get it to land on top of the monkeys, our plan will succeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that plan sounds perfect!
Now, who do you need doing what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need you to egg the monkeys on, Tsukasa. As for the crucial role of the person holding the bucket...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, I'd like to ask you to be the one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that means Nene gets to be the star again!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, why me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because the monkeys took the bananas from you. If they see you again, they may believe that they'll be able to steal whatever else you're carrying.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You and I will be in charge of casting the net, Emu. While you carefully show the monkeys what's in our bucket, Nene, we'll need you to somehow lure them towards us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And when they get close enough, we'll jump out and capture them with our net!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay, I understand the plan, but these are wild monkeys we're talking about...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm sure you'll do just fine, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I know you must be very scared.
I mean, it's not like you go around chasing after wild monkeys on a day-to-day basis.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I know you're able to take on even scarier challenges, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even scarier...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about when I got those bananas down...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, that too!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I was talking about something closer to home. And it's not just Nene. It's something that Tsukasa, the others and I have experienced before several times.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you talking about our shows...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Correct♪
The moment before you go on stage is always a little scary because you're worried about how things will go and how the audience will react, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I've seen you overcome that countless times, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <She's right...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You must've also had to muster up quite a bit of courage to start performing on stage again after taking a break from it, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And the way you ad-libbed a song after Robo-Nene malfunctioned was so wonderful too...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: L-Look, I appreciate what you're all trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Standing on stage can be scary, but trying to fool some monkeys seems like a different story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But they sorta have a point. The tension in the air before the curtains go up, being scared of forgetting my lines or worrying about staying in pitch during a song...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Compared to all that, this is...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll be fine, Nene. Because...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <All you have to do is remember everything that you went through and think about how you were able to overcome all those situations...!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, I've gotta be brave...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can do this. I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They're all here with me.
So I should be fine this time too...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come here...!)
